data.gender_notes: Ark is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Ark is recorded in name-lists as “Vessel of salvation”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ark expresses “Vessel of salvation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ark total 12, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: נוֹאַר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: a large, strong, wooden chest used for carrying, preserving, or storing valuable items

in_greek.name: ναύσαρξ
in_greek.long_meaning: a large, watertight vessel used for transportation, especially of people or goods across water

in_latin.name: arca
in_latin.long_meaning: a large, solid container used for storing or transporting items

biblical_reference.note: In the Old Testament, the Ark of the Covenant was a wooden chest that contained the Ten Commandments and represented the presence of God among the Israelites. It was later carried by the Israelites as they journeyed through the wilderness, and was eventually housed in the Temple in Jerusalem.
